hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: Bonding-curve token launch hook that deploys new ERC-20 tokens into concentrated multi-chunk liquidity ranges, collects a 1% swap fee (split 50/50 between creator and platform fee receivers via afterSwapReturnsDelta), and automatically removes bonding-curve liquidity and migrates it to a full-range AMM pool once the bonding curve supply threshold is reached.
